{{See also|RPF Raspberry Pi series}}
===Hardware specification=== :;[[RPF Raspberry Pi 5]] (4GB/8GB) *CPU: [[Broadcom]] BCM2712 @2.4GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) *GPU: [[Broadcom]] VideoCore VII :OpenGL ES 3.1, Vulkan 1.2, :H.265 (HEVC) (up to 4Kp60 decode), :H.264 (up to 1080p60 decode, 1080p30 encode) *Storage: TF card (max.512GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 4/8GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Cypress]] ([[Infineon]]) CYW43455 (1T1R) :SDIO 3.0: Wi-Fi 802.11ac, UART/PCM: BT 5.0 LE *Network: 1x 1GbE port *USB: 2x USB 3.0 (Host), 2x USB 2.0 (Host) ports *PCIe: PCIe 2.0 x1 via ribbon cable *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port
